Claude Opus 5 (max): Anthropic; flagship frontier reasoning and agentic model; 1M context window (128K max output); pricing at $5.00 / $25.00 per 1M input/output tokens.[1][2][3][4]
 Claude Fable 5 (with fallback): Anthropic; Mythosclass reasoning and multimodal model with Opus fallback integration; 1M context window; pricing at $10.00 / $50.00 per 1M input/output tokens.[3][5][6][7]
 GPT5.6 Sol (max): OpenAI; flagship multiagent reasoning, deep coding, and autonomous workflow model; ~1.05M–1.1M context window (128K max output); pricing at $5.00 / $30.00 per 1M input/output tokens.[2][8][9][10][1]
 Grok 4.6 (xhigh): xAI; realtime knowledge, highspeed coding, and agentic reasoning model; 500K context window; pricing at $2.00 / $6.00 per 1M input/output tokens ($0.50 cache hits).[4][8][11][2]
 Kimi K3 (max): Moonshot AI; frontier MoE model specialized in deep reasoning, mathematics, and web development; ~1M–1.05M context window; pricing at $3.00 / $15.00 per 1M input/output tokens.[10][12][13][14]
 GLM5.3 (max): Zhipu AI (Z.ai); highefficiency openarchitecture reasoning and agentic model; 1M context window; pricing at $1.40 / $4.40 per 1M input/output tokens.[13][14][15][10]
 Qwen3.8 Max: Alibaba Cloud; 2.4T total parameter sparse MoE model (~95B active); 1M context window with multimodal (text, image, video) support; pricing at $2.00 / $6.00 per 1M input/output tokens.[14][15][16][10]
 Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B: Alibaba Cloud; explicit architecture configuration of Qwen3.8 Max featuring 2.4 trillion total parameters with 95 billion active parameters per token.[15][16]
 Muse Spark 1.2 (xhigh): Meta; highthroughput coding and reasoning model with contributor tiering; ~1.05M (1,048,576) context window; pricing at $1.25 / $4.25 per 1M input/output tokens on OpenRouter.[17][18][19][20]
 Gemini 3.7 Flash (high): Google; lightweight multimodal model supporting text, vision, audio, and video processing; 1M context window; pricing at $0.75 / $3.75 per 1M input/output tokens.[5][7][21][22]
 DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 (max): DeepSeek; checkpointspecific frontier coding and terminalexecution MoE model; ~1.05M (1,048,576) context window; pricing at $0.66 / $1.98 per 1M input/output tokens.[18][19][20][17]
 Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh): Alibaba Cloud; dense/compact openweight model optimized for lowlatency coding and agent tasks; Apache 2.0 license; pricing at $0.50 / $3.00 per 1M input/output tokens.[10]
 Motif 3: Motif AI; specialized enterprise workflow, structured data extraction, and process automation language model.
 MiniMaxM3: MiniMax; multimodal longcontext MoE model built for agentic task completion and extended tool use.[15]
 DeepSeek V4 Pro (max): DeepSeek; flagship largescale sparse MoE reasoning model optimized for costeffective software engineering and analytical workflows.[16][20][17]
 MiMoV2.5Pro: Xiaomi / MiMo AI; edgetocloud multimodal model tailored for device integration, personal assistant agents, and visionlanguage tasks.
 Inkling: Inkling AI; domainspecific creative synthesis, document comprehension, and interactive editing model.
 Hy3: Tencent / Hunyuan; foundation model focused on bilingual reasoning, enterprise search, and complex multiturn dialogue.
 Ling 3.0 Flash: 01.AI (Ling); lowlatency, highefficiency distilled model optimized for rapid response generation and lightweight agent serving.
